newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian bourse,banks seen sideways after fast rise.
newsitem.headline: Belgian bourse,banks seen sideways after fast rise.

text.p: Belgian stocks could trade sideways on Tuesday after breaking new records on Monday in a session dominated by another bout of bank merger fever, traders and analysts said.
"I would like the market to consolidate, as it did on Friday, for a few days. It needs it," Gert De Mesure of Antwerp brokerage Delen & Co said.

"If you look elsewhere in Europe and after the Dutch rate hike it could be time to take some profits in equities," a trader at a Ghent-based brokerage added. "But it's difficult to say when, when we have new records every day."
